#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int longestWords(const string& line) {
    int best = 0;
    stringstream ss(line);
    string word;
    while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
        best = max(best, (int)word.length());
    }
    return best;
}

long long countInside(const string& inner) {
    long long count = 0;
    stringstream ss(inner);
    string part;
    while (getline(ss, part, '_')) {
        if (!part.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    regex pattern("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
    smatch match;
    string::const_iterator searchStart(s.cbegin());
    int longest = 0;
    long long inside = 0;
    int prev = 0;

    while (regex_search(searchStart, s.cend(), match, pattern)) {
        int start = match.position() + (searchStart - s.cbegin());
        int end = start + match.length();
        // Process text before this match
        string before = s.substr(prev, start - prev);
        longest = max(longest, longestWords(before));
        // Process inside parentheses
        string inner = match.str().substr(1, match.str().length() - 2);
        inside += countInside(inner);
        prev = end;
        searchStart = match.suffix().first;
    }
    // Process remaining text after last match
    if (prev < (int)s.length()) {
        string after = s.substr(prev);
        longest = max(longest, longestWords(after));
    }

    cout << longest << " " << inside << endl;
    return 0;
}
